headline: Rashmika Mandanna appointed brand ambassador for Aeroplane Rice and FMCG
hook: New celebrity face for Aeroplane Rice

modes.bear: High endorsement costs may pressure near-term margins without guaranteeing a proportional jump in sales volume.

modes.simple: The company behind Aeroplane Rice hired actor Rashmika Mandanna to promote its products, aiming to attract more shoppers.

summary: Amir Chand Jagdish Kumar (Exports) Limited announced that actor Rashmika Mandanna has been signed as the brand ambassador for its Aeroplane Rice and FMCG product lines.
